sources.title: Atlassian cuts another 1,600 jobs amid AI shakeup
sources.description: Mike Cannon-Brookes has announced a 10% reduction in Atlassian's global workforce, saying the company must adapt quickly to fund AI and enterprise growth while moving toward sustained profitability.

sources.title: Atlassian to Reduce 1,600 Jobs in the Latest AI-Linked Cuts (1)
sources.description: Atlassian Corp. plans to cut 1,600 jobs or a 10th of its global workforce, joining rivals in slashing staffing to cope with the advent of AI and a broader post-Covid industry slowdown.

sources.title: Atlassian lays off 1,600 as it ramps up AI investment - BusinessToday
sources.description: Atlassian layoffs: The company said the majority of impacted employees are based in North America, accounting for about 40% of the layoffs, followed by roughly 30% in Australia and around 16% in India.

sources.title: Atlassian lays off another 200 customer service, support staff
sources.description: The company came to the decision after its customer experience improvements to platform and tools reduced support needs, a spokesperson told CX Dive.

sources.title: Atlassian denies AI is behind customer service job cuts
sources.description: Australian software company job losses spark debate about impact of AI on jobs
